_rules.targeting: Every targeted notification payload carries `to`: an ARRAY of user id strings. The frontend shows the notification only when the authenticated user id is inside `to`. A payload without `to` is a broadcast and every connected client shows it.
_rules.delivery: Recipients who are online (User.is_active) get the socket event. Recipients who are offline get a web push notification instead, when they have an active push subscription. This logic lives in backend/utilities/notify.js.
_rules.messages: All messages use simple English with correct grammar and no special symbols or icons.
_rules.frontend_mirror: This file is mirrored at frontend/src/core/constants/events.socket.json. Update both together.

visitor_assigned.sent_to: The specific employee when a provider is chosen; otherwise the users of the target unit; otherwise all users of the target department and its units
visitor_assigned.why: Tells staff a visitor was assigned to them. Carries assigned_total, waiting_total, and the live queue of the department.

you_forgot_to_stop_service.sent_to: The provider who was serving the visitor
you_forgot_to_stop_service.why: Warns a provider that their service was stopped automatically because the visitor left.

parking_alert.sent_to: All gate registrars (roles matching gate, vehicle, or entrance)
parking_alert.why: Alerts the gates that a vehicle has overstayed its allowed parking time.

new_announcement.sent_to: The heads of the target department, or all department heads when published to all departments
new_announcement.why: Delivers a published announcement, notice, or directive to the department heads it belongs to.

notifications.why: General staff activity messages, such as a user marking themselves active or inactive.

global_notification.why: A manual broadcast sent by an authenticated user to everyone.

visitor_checkedin.sent_to: Everyone connected (reception and dashboards react to it)
visitor_checkedin.why: A visitor checked in. Pages refresh their visitor lists and show a toast.

visitor_checkedout.sent_to: Everyone connected (reception and dashboards react to it)
visitor_checkedout.why: A visitor checked out. Pages refresh their visitor lists and show a toast.

car_checkedin.sent_to: Everyone connected (gate pages react to it)
car_checkedin.why: A car checked in at the gate. Pages refresh parking data and show a toast.

car_checkedout.sent_to: Everyone connected (gate pages react to it)
car_checkedout.why: A car checked out at the gate. Pages refresh parking data and show a toast.

service_status_updated.why: A visitor service started or ended. Dashboards refresh their queues.

leave_return.why: A visitor stepped outside or returned. Dashboards refresh their lists.

feedback_submitted.why: A visitor submitted feedback. Dashboards refresh their statistics.

parking_update.sent_to: Everyone connected (parking pages react to it)
parking_update.why: Live refresh signal for parking slots and reservations. Not a user notification.

active_user.why: Presence signal that a user came online.

inactive_user.why: Presence signal that a user went offline.

smartparking_test.why: Diagnostic test event for the smart parking realtime channel.

service_delivery_test.why: Diagnostic test event for the service delivery realtime channel.

dcs_approval_requested.sent_to: The registered user whose email is the approver of a DCS submission that is now waiting for their decision
dcs_approval_requested.why: Tells an approver with an account that data is waiting for their approval. Carries data.link, the approval page URL, and data.link_label for the panel's action link.

deprecated_events.new_visitor_assigned: Replaced by visitor_assigned, which is targeted with a `to` array.
deprecated_events.new_visitor_assigned_to_your_department: Replaced by visitor_assigned, which is targeted with a `to` array.
deprecated_events.car_checkout: Never emitted by the backend. The real event name is car_checkedout.
deprecated_events.visitor_checkout: Never emitted by the backend. The real event name is visitor_checkedout.
